ICE Acquires US Army-Rejected Shock Gloves for Border Patrol

US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) is acquiring electric shock gloves that a US Army study found caused excessive pain, compliance, and fear. The Army had deemed the gloves too painful for its own use. ICE's acquisition of these gloves for its border patrol operations has been reported.
